verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's published pages show online filing for LLC and corporation formation. For annual reports, the pages point to a keyless entry path: refer to the notice (document number) or search records by name. They also list the prepaid E-File Account as only one payment option alongside credit and debit card, which implies no account is required to file. None of the pages explicitly states that formation or annual-report filing can start without an account, and no hands-on check of the e-file host was done. missing for 10: explicit documentation that no account or login is needed to start the formation flow, explicit file-number entry instructions for the core filing, independent or hands-on confirmation of the entry path.
